options.description: The reviewer's finding on your wording is shown to you as a proposal and nothing in your text changes. Formatting and layout fixes are still applied directly. Recommended: Suggesting only keeps your words in your hands while still giving you the reviewer's view, and it does not change the layout fixes that protect the quality of the delivered documents.
options.label: Suggest only (Recommended)

options.description: The agent changes your wording itself when a reviewer flags it. Your text can change without you approving each edit.
options.label: Apply automatically

options.description: Findings on your wording are dropped and never shown. You will not see them, and only layout and formatting fixes are made.
options.label: Ignore wording findings
